The FDA has assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of February 28, 2027.

Lasofoxifene • On August 14, 2026, LeonaBio announced it is on track to complete enrollment of approximately 600 patients in the Phase 3 Elaine-3 clinical trial evaluating lasofoxifene in ER-positive (ER+), HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated metastatic breast cancer in the fourth quarter of 2026 with topline data expected in the second half of 2027.

• On August 5, 2026, Mirum Pharmaceuticals announced enrollment was completed in the VANTAGE Phase 2b study of volixibat in cholestatic pruritus due to primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) with topline results expected in the first quarter of 2027.
• On October 14, 2026, Rezolute announced completion of enrollment in the Phase 3 study of ersodetug in tumor HI and topline data is expected mid-December 2026.
